questions.question: Determine the direction of the text for deworming measures. / [CO4]
questions.solution_html:
• Pointers to the infestination of worms and its treatment
  • Chapter-तǽͬचͩक×सा - æलोकः८, æलोकः१०
  • If the fruits and flowers wither without any particular reason or symptoms
  • of ailments and the trunk remains healthy, we are to realize that the
  • worms have infiltrated the roots, We are to remove them manually.
  • Following this, the roots ought to be applied with the urine of cow mixed
  • with vidanga, sarshapa and tila laced with clarified butter. Fumigation with
  • the same drugs should be done. Once the infestation is cured, the tree
  • is moistened with milk mixed with water resuscitating the tree into full
  • bloom.
  • The bark of karanja, aaragvadha, arishta, saptaparna along with musta,
  • and vidanga along with gomootra may be used fur irrigation to relieve
  • worm infestation.
